items.q: So Bubba was a wa-wa with the mute. He made that famous (unintelligible) with Duke.

ctx.x: I mean, now, when you're talking with Bubba Miley and Joe Smith, I mean what would they have to say to each other, because that's totally different, isn't it?
Two different types, the same as day and night, altogether different. So Bubba was a wa-wa with the mute. He made that famous (unintelligible) with Duke.
Is that true that, somebody told me that, they said that Bubba's open tone was not good.
